birth_plan.src: Have you set aside money, arranged transport, and found someone to give blood? Press 1 for yes, 2 for not yet.
birth_plan.t: A zaŋ liɣiri zali, ka zaŋ gbɔna n-nya ka so zaŋ ti ʒim? Zaŋmiya yim na sani, ka di na bi paai.

birth_plan_no.src: Please arrange money, transport and a blood donor before the birth. Your health worker will help you.
birth_plan_no.t: Dimya suɣulo, zaŋmiya liɣiri mini ʒim zaŋ chaŋ dɔɣibu polo. A daalaafee tuntumdiba ni sɔŋ a.

birth_plan_yes.src: That is good. Keep the money and the transport ready.
birth_plan_yes.t: Di viɛla. Gbibi liɣiri maa mini lɔndo maa shili.

closing.src: Thank you. We will send the date by message. Goodbye.
closing.t: M-paɣiri a. Ti ni ti zaŋ zilinli dihili na. Pumpɔŋɔ.

danger_bleeding.src: Are you bleeding from the birth canal? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_bleeding.t: A dɔɣiri kambɔŋ ni ʒim mali a? Kpɛm’ 1 ni o sani, 2 zuɣu anahi.

danger_convulsions.src: Have you had fits or convulsions? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_convulsions.t: A mali naŋgbankpeeni bee n-nyeri naŋgbaŋkpeeni? Kpɛm’ 1 ni o sani, 2 zuɣu anahi.

danger_fever.src: Do you have a fever? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_fever.t: A mali fiiba? Kpɛm’ 1 ni o sani, 2 zuɣu anahi.

danger_reduced_fetal_movement.src: Has the baby stopped moving, or moved much less? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_reduced_fetal_movement.t: Biliɛɣu maa chɛ n-chani bee n-chɛ n-naai? Kpɛm’ 1 ni o sani, 2 zuɣu anahi.

danger_severe_headache.src: Do you have a bad headache, or blurred vision? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_severe_headache.t: A mali zuɣuyaali talima bee ʒiɛ’ titali? Kpɛm’ 1 ni o sani, 2 zuɣu anahi.

diet_breastmilk.src: Did the child take breast milk yesterday?
diet_breastmilk.t: Bia maa zaŋ bihim saha shɛli n-kpuɣi bihili?

diet_dark_leafy.src: Did you eat green leaves yesterday, like ayoyo or baobab leaf?
diet_dark_leafy.t: A sa di momaha, kaman ayoyo bee tua?

diet_eggs.src: Did you eat an egg yesterday?

diet_flesh.src: Did you eat fish or meat yesterday, even dried fish?
diet_flesh.t: A sa di zahim bee nimdi zaashee, hali zahim kuuya?

diet_grains.src: Did you eat porridge, tuo zaafi, rice or yam yesterday?
diet_grains.t: A sa di kɔriŋga, tuafi, shinkaafa bee nyuli?

diet_intro.src: Now a few questions about what you ate yesterday.
diet_intro.t: Pumpɔŋɔ biɛla ka a sa di bindirigu maa yɛla.

diet_nuts_seeds.src: Did you eat groundnut or dawadawa yesterday?
diet_nuts_seeds.t: A sa di sima bee nyuya?

diet_other_fruit.src: Did you eat any other fruit yesterday?

diet_other_fruit_veg.src: Did the child eat any other fruit or vegetable yesterday?
diet_other_fruit_veg.t: Bia maa sa di wala bee ʒiɛvari’ shɛl’ la?

diet_other_veg.src: Did you eat okra, tomato or garden egg yesterday?
diet_other_veg.t: Nyini n-saɣim diri maana bee kambɔŋ bee sima?

diet_pulses.src: Did you eat beans or bambara yesterday?
diet_pulses.t: A sa di tuya bee tuya?

diet_pulses_nuts_seeds.src: Did the child eat beans or groundnut yesterday?
diet_pulses_nuts_seeds.t: Bia maa sa ŋubi tuya bee sima?

diet_vita_fruit_veg.src: Did you eat mango, pawpaw or orange sweet potato yesterday?
diet_vita_fruit_veg.t: A sa di mango, gɔnda bee leemu diya?

driver_accepted.src: Thank you. Please go now. The health worker will call you.
driver_accepted.t: M-paɣiri a. Dim suɣulo, cham’ pɔi. Alaafeelana tuuntumdiba ni boli a.

driver_declined.src: Thank you. We will ask another driver.
driver_declined.t: M-paɣiri a. Ti ni bɔhi dɔriba so.

driver_request.src: Urgent. A woman needs transport to the health centre. Press 1 to accept, 2 if you cannot come.
driver_request.t: Kpaŋmi noli. Paɣa bɔrila lɔri sɔŋdi n-chaŋ alaafee tudu polo. Kpalim’ napɔŋ ni a deei, 2 a yi ku tooi kana.

escape_hint.src: At any time, press 9 to speak to a nurse.
escape_hint.t: Saha shɛlikam, zaŋmi awei n-tɔɣisi nɛma yɛtɔɣa.

food_bambara.src: Bambara beans keep from harvest and are filling. Cook them for the family this week.
food_bambara.t: Bamba tuya ka chɛ atam ka pali. Duɣimi li tiri yili ŋɔ bakɔi ŋɔ.

food_baobab_fruit.src: Mix baobab fruit powder into water or porridge. It is very high in vitamin C, which helps the body take up iron.
food_baobab_fruit.t: Zaŋmi tua wala n-niŋ kom bee kɔringa. Vitamin C zuɣu ka di du pam, din sɔŋdi ka niŋgbuŋ zaŋ kuriti.

food_baobab_leaf.src: Stir a handful of dried baobab leaf powder into the soup. The tree is in the compound and the powder keeps all year.
food_baobab_leaf.t: Tua kuma tulaale zim kpɛm’ ʒiɛri ni. Tia maa be tiŋgban’ ni ka doli tabili yuun’ muni puuni zaa.

food_cassava.src: Cassava is available. Use it as the base, but add groundnut or fish so it is not starch alone.
food_cassava.t: Kambɔŋ beni. Zaŋmiya li leei bintaɣindili, amaa pahimi sima bee zahim din ni chɛ ka di pala taŋkpaɣu di kɔŋko.

food_cowpea.src: Cook beans twice this week. They store well and build the blood.
food_cowpea.t: Duɣimi tuya diba ayi bakɔi ŋɔ. Bɛ dɔɣiri viɛnyɛliŋga m-me ʒim maa.

food_dawadawa.src: Cook with dawadawa. It is rich in iron and it is already in most kitchens.
food_dawadawa.t: Niŋmiya daadawa duɣibu. Kurugu buni ka di pun be jaara ni pam.

food_dawadawa_fruit.src: The yellow pulp inside the dawadawa pod is sweet and free. Give it to the child instead of buying fruit.
food_dawadawa_fruit.t: Dovihi tarili din be dɔyili puuni nyɛla din mali nyaɣisa ka mali biɛɣu. Zaŋmiya li ti bia maa ka pa ni wain tihi wala.

food_dried_fish.src: Pound dried small fish into powder and stir a spoon into the porridge. It is cheap, and the whole fish gives both iron and calcium.
food_dried_fish.t: Pɔŋ nyuuŋ zahim bihi n-zaŋ lɔɣiri duɣu n-niŋ kɔriŋga ni. Di mali alaha, ka ziŋa zaa tiri kuriti mini calcium zaa.

food_eggs.src: One egg for the child, most days, if you can manage it.
food_eggs.t: Gala yini n-ti bilɛɣu maa, dabisa pam, a yi tooi nyaŋ li.

food_fresh_fish.src: Fresh fish is available in the rains.
food_fresh_fish.t: Ziŋ’ palli be saa maa ni.

food_garden_egg.src: Garden eggs are cheap this season.

food_goat.src: Goat meat when there is money for it.
food_goat.t: Niŋgbun duɣili yi ti liɣiri kani.

food_groundnut.src: Add a spoon of groundnut paste to the porridge. It stores from harvest and adds energy the child needs to grow.
food_groundnut.t: Zaŋmi sima niŋ kɔringa ni. Di tɔri atam kpuɣibu ni, ka pahi bia maa ni simdi ni o zooi nɔŋa.

food_guinea_fowl.src: Guinea fowl when the household can afford it.
food_guinea_fowl.t: Kpini noo yi mali yili ni tooi nya o.

food_kenaf.src: Bito leaves are in season. Add them to the soup.
food_kenaf.t: Bito vari n-nyɛ saha. Pahimi li ʒiɛri maa ni.

food_maize.src: Maize from the harvest store. Use it as the base of the porridge.
food_maize.t: Chɛli atam kpuɣibu shee ni. Zaŋmiya li leei kɔringa la gbinni.

food_mango.src: Mangoes are ripe. Give the child one every day while they last — they carry vitamin A right into the lean months.
food_mango.t: Mɔnguliya biya. Zaŋmi bia maa tim dabisili kam ka bɛ naai di nyɛla bɛ ʒirila vitamin A n-ti paai chira dimli ni.

food_milk_fermented.src: Fermented milk is around during the rains — good for the child.
food_milk_fermented.t: Bihim kpɛma bela saa ni saa viɛla n-ti bilɛɣu maa.

food_milk_fresh.src: Fresh milk while the cattle are producing.

food_millet.src: Millet koko is fine as a base, but enrich it — plain koko alone is mostly water.
food_millet.t: Guŋgɔŋ nyɛla din viɛla pam, amaa lee booni li buchihili. Gumdi' pamli n-nyɛ kom.

food_moringa.src: Pick moringa leaves, dry them, and add two spoons to the porridge or soup. It costs nothing and grows through the dry season.
food_moringa.t: Piim’ omaŋa vari, n-zaŋ li niŋ kɔriŋga bee ʒiɛri. Di bi lan lari ka bi bili wum saha.

food_okra_dried.src: Dried okra keeps all year. Add it to the soup.
food_okra_dried.t: Kɔrɛ kpɛm’ gbibi yuun’ muni puuni zaa. Pahimi li ʒiɛri maa zuɣu.

food_okra_fresh.src: Fresh okra is in the market now.

food_orange.src: Oranges are cheap now. Eat one with the beans — the vitamin C helps the iron get in.
food_orange.t: Wanzam mali alaha. Dim niŋ tuya ni yino, vitamin C n-sɔŋdi ka kuriti kpɛbu.

food_pawpaw.src: Pawpaw is available. Half a pawpaw covers the child's vitamin A.
food_pawpaw.t: Paɣpaa beni. Daantaliga pirigili n limsiri bia maa vitamin A.

food_shea_butter.src: A little shea butter in the food helps the body take up vitamin A.
food_shea_butter.t: Biliɛɣu din be bindirigu ni biɛla sɔŋdi niŋgbuŋ ni yihiri vitamin A.

food_shea_fruit.src: Shea fruit is ripe now and free. Eat the sweet pulp — it comes exactly when the stores are lowest.
food_shea_fruit.t: Taa walli biya pam na pumpɔŋɔ n-chɛ n-chihi li. Dim salinli din nyaɣisi pam la, di yi paai feeranim’ din be tiŋli la shee.

food_sorghum.src: Sorghum from the store, as the porridge base.
food_sorghum.t: Ŋariŋga din nyɛ kɔringa, kɔringa zuɣu.

food_soybean.src: Roast and grind soybean into the Tom Brown. It makes the same porridge far stronger.
food_soybean.t: Ŋmɛmiya n-nɛm bɛ nina kpɛhi Brown puuni. Di chɛrimi ka kɔringa la kpeeni n-kpɛh’ o kpee.

food_sweet_potato.src: Orange sweet potato is in season and is one of the best sources of vitamin A you can grow.
food_sweet_potato.t: Ŋariŋga duɣu bela vitamin A ni tooi zooi nyɛla din viɛla.

food_tom_brown.src: Make Tom Brown with roasted maize, soybean and groundnut together — not maize alone. Same porridge, far more in it.
food_tom_brown.t: Zaŋmiya kawana, kaman sima ni sima niŋ shɛlɔrigu, pa kawana n-kpalim. Kɔringa ŋɔ n-wɔɣa pam di zuɣu.

food_tomato.src: Tomatoes are in season and cheap now. Cook them with iron-rich food — they help the body absorb it.
food_tomato.t: Gumachuɣu bela saha, ka be alahachi pumpɔŋɔ. Niŋdi ba alali n-doya ba, bɛ sɔŋdi ka niŋgbuŋ nyɔɣiri li.

food_wild_greens.src: Ayoyo and aleefu are growing now. Cook a handful into the soup — they cost nothing during the rains.
food_wild_greens.t: Ayoya minii alijefu zaa kul zoorimi pumpɔŋɔ. Duɣimi ʒiɛri maa kpaŋ ŋ-ŋmabu n-kpɛri ʒiɛri saa ni.

food_yam.src: New yam is in. Use it as the meal base.
food_yam.t: Nyuli palli be ni. Zaŋmiya li leei bindirigu shee.

greet_consent.src: Hello. This is Mabia, about your pregnancy. Is this a good time to talk? Press 1 for yes, 2 for later.
greet_consent.t: Mbomi. Mabia yuli booni a puli ni. Lala saha suŋ n-nyɛ yɛligu? Chɛli di 1 zuɣu, di saha n-ti paai 2.

hotline_greet.src: Hello. This is Mabia. We are calling you back so this call costs you nothing.
hotline_greet.t: Mbomi. Mabia ŋɔ m-bɔŋɔ. Ti boli a labisi ka a boligu ŋɔ bahi yoli.

hotline_menu.src: Press 1 if this is an emergency. Press 9 to speak to a nurse.
hotline_menu.t: Kpahimmi dimbɔŋɔ yi nyɛ la barina. Kpahimmiya dolibu n-ti yɛli nɛɣu.

next_visit_prefix.t: A kaabu nyaaŋa nyɛla din be.

no_answer.src: We could not hear any answer. Your health worker will visit you. Goodbye.
no_answer.t: Ti kɔŋ labisibu. A daalaafee tuntumdiba ni kaai a. Pumpɔŋɔ.

not_understood.src: Sorry, I did not get that.
not_understood.t: Gaafara, n daa bi baŋ lala.

nurse_connecting.src: Please hold. We are connecting you to a nurse.
nurse_connecting.t: Dim suɣulo, gbibi. Ti zaŋ nyini tabili nɛma.

nurse_unavailable.src: We could not reach a nurse just now. Your health worker has been told, and someone will call you back. Goodbye.
nurse_unavailable.t: Ti kɔŋ nɛma paai nɛɣu pumpɔŋɔ. bɛ yɛli a daalaafee tuntumdiba, ka so n-lee boli a labisi. Pumpɔŋɔ.

red_closing.src: Thank you. Your health worker is being told now, and someone will call you. Please do not travel alone. Goodbye.
red_closing.t: M-paɣiri a. A daalaafee tuntumdiba yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ, ka so ni bol’ a. Dim suɣulo, di doliya soli. Pumpɔŋɔ.

reschedule.src: That is fine. We will call you another time. Goodbye.
reschedule.t: Di viɛla. Ti ni boli ya la saha shɛli. Pumpɔŋɔ.

birth_plan.src: Have you set aside money, arranged transport, and found someone to give blood? Press 1 for yes, 2 for not yet.
birth_plan.t: Fʋ ɛɛnti gɔs ligidi bas, gɔsid lɔɔm, ka nyɛ sɔ' ye o tis ziim? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ na pʋ paae.

birth_plan_no.src: Please arrange money, transport and a blood donor before the birth. Your health worker will help you.
birth_plan_no.t: Zaam zaŋi keŋ ligidi, lɔr nɛ ziim tisib ka pʋ du'am. Fʋ nimma'asim tʋmtʋmnib na sʋŋif.

birth_plan_yes.src: That is good. Keep the money and the transport ready.
birth_plan_yes.t: Di an sʋm. Kpɛlim ligidi la nɛ lɔr la ti'ebʋg.

danger_bleeding.src: Are you bleeding from the birth canal? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_bleeding.t: Fʋ mɔr ziim nɛ du'a la ni? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ anaasi.

danger_convulsions.src: Have you had fits or convulsions? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_convulsions.t: Fʋ mɔr nɔŋgbannwa'ar bɛɛ fʋ mɔr vʋ'ʋsʋg? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ anaasi.

danger_fever.src: Do you have a fever? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_fever.t: Fʋ mɔr pɛbisim? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ anaasi.

danger_reduced_fetal_movement.src: Has the baby stopped moving, or moved much less? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_reduced_fetal_movement.t: Biig la basi keŋ tuonɛ, bɛɛ kpɛn'ɛs bi'elaa? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ anaasi.

danger_severe_headache.src: Do you have a bad headache, or blurred vision? Press 1 for yes, 2 for no.
danger_severe_headache.t: Fʋ mɔr zugbɛ'ɛd bɛ'ɛd, bɛɛ pʋ mɔr zin'ig? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 nɛ anaasi.

diet_intro.src: Now a few questions about what you ate yesterday.
diet_intro.t: Nananna bu'os biela zaŋi keŋ dinɛ ka fʋ sa diid.

greet_consent.src: Hello. This is Mabia, about your pregnancy. Is this a good time to talk? Press 1 for yes, 2 for later.
greet_consent.t: Mɔr sʋ'ʋŋa. Nɛ'ɛŋa anɛ Mabia, buon ye fʋ pʋʋg gɔsid. Nɛ’ɛŋa anɛ saŋa sʋŋ ye di pian’a? Nwɛnɛ 1 tis ɛɛ, 2 ti paae nya'aŋ. Saŋa wʋsa, kpɛm 9 ye o pian' nɛɛs.

next_visit_prefix.t: Fʋ keŋ tuon ken la bɛnɛ ni.

reschedule.src: That is fine. We will call you another time. Goodbye.
reschedule.t: Di anɛ dinɛ an sʋm. Ti na buonif saŋa lɛɛ. Sʋ'ʋŋa.
